title: Three Months and One Short Scale
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：money　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 money 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the shopkeeper ① saved the money that no buyer in the shop would have measured, and he said the saving was the whole of the month. The ② money, meaning the coin itself and not the scale, ran three months and stayed unmeasured in the book; money, he said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ item of money in that shop had the same short scale beside it, and the ④ money at the far counter, meaning the coin they kept for the children to count and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Money, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the shopkeeper said the measuring is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the money was the whole of the matter, meaning the power and not the coin. The ⑥ money, meaning the power and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; money, he said, is either something you save or the only word that means both coin and a power. He said the power is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ money had become a line in an account, and the account had become an argument about the short scale. The ⑧ money of the whole thing, the shopkeeper wrote in July, was one shop and three months of measuring; money, he said, is either the coin at the far counter or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ money I remember is the money measured in the account, which closed in 1975 and is still measured as the quietest in the shop. ⑩ Money, my mother said in 1977, is the only thing that improves by being measured; all money, she said, is a power that has agreed to look like coin. She said the power was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 钱；金钱（指铺子里每一件旁边的那一件）
B. n. 钱；金钱（指那笔钱本身，与小小的秤相对）
C. 固定搭配：save the money 攒这一笔钱
D. n. 钱；金钱（指留给孩子们数的那一枚）
E. n. 钱之事（抽象总称，指一处铺子的钱之事）
F. n. 钱；金钱（指账本里写到、被测量的那一笔）
G. n. 钱、底气（指一件事里人人都买却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 底气（抽象总称，指人人都买却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: saved the money that no buyer in the shop would have measured

answers.why: save the money 意为“攒这一笔钱”，1968 年那位掌柜把铺子里没有一位买主肯测量的一笔钱做了一遍。
money 意为“钱；金钱”，指那笔钱本身而不是小小的秤，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被测量。
money 意为“钱；金钱”，指铺子里每一件旁边的那一件，每一件旁边都有同一杆小小的秤。
money 意为“钱；金钱”，指最远那张柜台的留给孩子们数的那一枚，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
money 意为“钱、底气”，指一件事里人人都买却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这笔底气就是那件事的全部。
money 意为“底气”，指人人都买却无人提起的那样东西而不是那笔钱，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
money 意为“钱；金钱”，指账本里写到、被测量的那一笔，到 1973 年这一笔成了账本里的一行。
money 意为“钱之事”，掌柜七月写道，整件事的钱之事是一处铺子和三个月份的测量。
money 意为“钱；金钱”，我记得的是账本里测量过的那一笔，1975 年结清了，至今仍被说成铺子里最安静的一笔。
money 为抽象总称，母亲 1977 年说，钱是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的钱。
